name: techvenza
description: Techvenza — dynamic WordPress publication (block theme + core plugin)

scripts.mailpit:hint: node -e "console.log('\nWordPress: http://localhost:8888  (admin / password)\nFor email capture run: docker run -d -p 8025:8025 -p 1025:1025 axllent/mailpit')"
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp techvenza seed
scripts.seed:reset: wp-env run cli wp techvenza reset --yes
scripts.seed:docker: docker compose run --rm cli techvenza seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php
scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:e2e
